title: 2015 China Crash & Yuan Devaluation
storyline: A margin-fuelled bubble in mainland stocks peaks in June 2015 and bursts. In August Beijing shocks markets by devaluing the yuan, and a second wave of selling hits in January 2016 alongside collapsing oil.

regime.name: Leveraged euphoria
regime.description: Mainland and Hong Kong stocks are surging on retail margin buying and hopes of policy easing. The Fed is preparing its first hike in years.

events.headline: PBoC cuts reserve ratio by 100bp, the biggest cut since 2008
events.altHeadline: Central bank cuts bank reserve ratio by 100bp, the biggest cut in years
events.body: The move frees more than RMB 1 trillion for lending.

events.headline: Shanghai Composite tops 5,100 as regulator tightens margin-finance rules
events.altHeadline: Mainland stocks hit a seven-year high as the regulator curbs margin lending
events.body: Outstanding margin debt has quadrupled in a year.

events.headline: PBoC cuts rates and RRR after stocks plunge 19% in two weeks
events.altHeadline: Central bank cuts rates after mainland stocks plunge 19% in two weeks
events.body: It is the first simultaneous cut of both tools since 2008. Margin calls are accelerating.

events.headline: Half of mainland stocks halt trading; Beijing bans big shareholders from selling
events.altHeadline: Half of mainland-listed stocks halt trading; large holders banned from selling
events.body: Investors unable to sell on the mainland are dumping Hong Kong shares instead.

events.headline: China devalues the yuan by 1.9% in surprise move
events.altHeadline: Beijing devalues its currency by nearly 2% in a surprise move
events.body: The central bank called it a one-off change to make the fixing more market-based.

events.headline: "Black Monday": Shanghai falls 8.5%, Dow drops 1,000 points at the open
events.altHeadline: Mainland stocks fall 8.5% in a day; global markets plunge at the open
events.body: Commodities and emerging-market currencies are also in free fall.

events.headline: PBoC cuts interest rates and reserve ratio again
events.altHeadline: Central bank cuts interest rates and the reserve ratio again
events.body: The one-year lending rate falls by 25bp and the reserve ratio by 50bp.

events.headline: PBoC cuts rates for the sixth time in a year
events.altHeadline: Central bank cuts rates for the sixth time in a year
events.body: It also removed the ceiling on deposit rates.

events.headline: Fed raises rates for the first time since 2006
events.altHeadline: Fed raises rates for the first time in nearly a decade
events.body: The Fed stressed that further increases will be gradual.

events.headline: New circuit breaker halts China trading on the first day of the year
events.altHeadline: New circuit breaker halts mainland trading for the day after a 7% fall
events.body: Weak factory data and a lower yuan fixing triggered the selling.

events.headline: China scraps circuit breaker after second halt; yuan fixed sharply weaker
events.altHeadline: Regulator scraps the circuit breaker after a second halt; currency fixed sharply weaker
events.body: Trading lasted less than 30 minutes before the halt.

events.headline: Hong Kong dollar hits weakest since 2007; HIBOR spikes, Hang Seng below 19,000
events.altHeadline: Hong Kong dollar slides toward the weak end of its band; interbank rates spike
events.body: Capital outflow fears are hitting local property and bank shares.

events.headline: Oil sinks to $26, a 13-year low; bank shares tumble worldwide
events.altHeadline: Oil sinks to a 13-year low; bank shares tumble worldwide
events.body: Investors fear energy-loan losses and negative interest rates will hurt banks.

events.headline: PBoC cuts reserve ratio by 50bp
events.altHeadline: Central bank cuts the bank reserve ratio by 50bp
events.body: The cut came days after G20 finance ministers met in Shanghai.
